confidence_notes: Rethymno's May 2026 Numbeo food data are local but based on only 18 contributors in the prior 18 months. Cocktail and wine estimates are inferred from the local draft-beer price; July accommodation estimates are broad seasonal model estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Rethymno's local price data. Accommodation estimates reflect July tourist demand in Rethymno and comparable Crete resort towns.
